item.title: MA November Median Home Price Up 5 Percent From 2024
item.description: PEABODY, Dec. 16, 2025 — The median price of a single-family home in Massachusetts rose 5 percent year-over-year in November, reaching $630,000. This marked a new all-time high for the month of November, but the median single-family home price was unchanged from the previous month, according to a new report from The Warren Group, a leading provider of national real estate and transaction data. The post MA November Median Home Price Up 5 Percent From 2024 appeared first on The Warren Group.
